bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
p="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei '(^|[-_])postgres([-_]|$)' | head -n 1)"
test -n "$p" || { echo STK04_POSTGRES_NOT_RUNNING; exit 62; }
echo STK04_SCHEMA_TABLES
docker exec "$p" sh -c 'psql -At -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d gaybbs -c "SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname=current_schema() ORDER BY tablename"' | grep -E 'posting_topics|posting_sticker_entry_pins|posting_deliveries' || true
echo STK04_CURRENT_TOPIC_ROWS
docker exec "$p" sh -c 'psql -At -F "|" -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d gaybbs -c "SELECT topic_id,board_key,purpose,chat_id,message_thread_id,title,enabled,verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_by IS NOT NULL FROM posting_topics WHERE chat_id=-1002373696859 ORDER BY topic_id LIMIT 100"' || echo STK04_TOPIC_REGISTRY_UNAVAILABLE
echo STK04_SCHEMA_AUDIT_DONE
